affinity.notes: Muted masonry dominates; amber runes read as activation rather than an element.

anatomy.notes: Blocky humanoid construction is coherent, weighty, and immediately readable.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "slow frontline bruiser" does not semantically communicate Program-Sequence Specialist (Specialist) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: Huge fists and heavy proportions clearly forecast slow, close-range impacts.

finish.notes: Stone, metal joints, and engraved panels receive consistent polished detail.

framing.notes: Full body and both fists remain clear inside a centered portrait.

identity.notes: Blind perception "rune-etched stone golem" semantically identifies golems/golem-rune-warrior.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "normal" is accepted for intended T3 under the documented v2 normalization.
